decision_basis: Required release evidence is missing. Under the evidence policy, favorable automated results cannot produce GO or NO-GO until the comparison is reproducible from immutable evaluated roots and durable artifacts and the required reviews are complete.

automated_evaluated_configuration_gate.claim: Treatment improved deterministic development results, preserved every passing holdout result, passed routing holdout, and introduced no undocumented critical or cost regression.
automated_evaluated_configuration_gate.scope: openai-codex/gpt-5.6-sol with OMP omp/18.1.17, profile skill-eval-isolated, thinking off, three attempts per case, and no tools
automated_evaluated_configuration_gate.release_effect: supporting evidence only; it does not satisfy the incomplete release gates

independent_model_judge.effect: supporting evidence only; human calibration and adjudication remain required

release_blockers.reason: The accepted results do not record immutable baseline and treatment catalog revisions and resolved roots.
No pre-registered comparison-contract path and content hash are recorded for the accepted comparison.
The legacy manifests record per-attempt max_time values, but not effective overall timeout values or an explicit baseline/treatment equality result.
No qualified human reviewer has scored and locked the 26 calibration pairs or adjudicated the model judge's 30 position-sensitive and 6 critical-flagged pairs.
No named qualified technical authority has attested correctness, safety, security, completeness, operational validity, and product terminology.
Raw artifacts exist only in local Git-ignored directories; immutable baseline and treatment artifact URIs and hashes, access policy, retention period, and responsible owner are unavailable.

supported_automated_claim: For the locally captured evaluated configuration only, deterministic behavior improved from 29/42 to 42/42 on development and from 24/36 to 36/36 on the independently frozen holdout; routing remained 30/30 on development and 36/36 on holdout. This observation is not release evidence until the incomplete gates are resolved.
unsupported_release_claims: generalization to other models, profiles, prompts, or repositories
